title: Observability launchpad collage + trace explainer for onboarding quickstart visuals
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact set of onboarding assets for the Observability section of the Quickstart/Launchpad flow. Deliverables: a 3-panel collage hero that highlights latency, cost-per-token, and a tracing timeline; annotated screenshots for docs; a short "How to read traces" explainer overlay; and two mobile-scaled screenshots for the in-app walkthrough. This ticket focuses on composition, copy alignment with product labeling (latency p50/p95, cost/token breakdown, span watermarks), and export-ready PNGs/WEBP for the docs site and in-console onboarding carousel. Avoid duplicating existing snapshot/quickstart imagery — instead use a collage approach and new naming conventions for axes and legend treatments. Include accessibility contrast checks and make one variant optimized for dark-mode console.

acceptance_criteria: Hero collage includes: p95 latency line, cost-per-token mini-bar, and a condensed trace timeline with one expanded span example.
Provide both light and dark variants exported at @1x and @2x in PNG and WEBP.
Annotated screenshots include numbered callouts that match Quickstart copy in Confluence.
Trace explainer overlay must fit within a 640x320 card and remain legible at mobile widths.
Accessibility: contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 for body text on imagery and colorblind-friendly palette for charts.
Assets uploaded to Drive and linked in Confluence; final files named with semantic suffixes and version numbers.
PM signoff and Accessibility review recorded in comments before closing.
Engineering notes on pixel offsets and export sizes handed off in 'notes_for_engineering'.
